findings.description: Stock release could exceed the Java int stock range because the SQL update did not enforce an upper bound.
findings.root_cause: The release UPDATE added any positive int quantity without checking whether the resulting stock remained representable by the API model.
findings.impact: Out-of-range persisted stock could produce inconsistent JDBC/API behavior.
findings.fix: Add an atomic upper-bound predicate and return 400 if the row exists but the release would exceed Integer.MAX_VALUE.
findings.verification: Regression test expects 400 and verifies stock remains unchanged at Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1.
findings.status: fixed; test added, execution blocked because no usable JDK/Maven is available
